dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.reading: Xiǎonán, nǐ lái le! Qǐng jìn, qǐng jìn!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 阿姨好！我来帮您做饭吧。
dialogue.reading: Āyí hǎo! Wǒ lái bāng nín zuòfàn ba.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: 好啊。王明，别把袜子扔在沙发上！
dialogue.reading: Hǎo a. Wáng Míng, bié bǎ wàzi rēng zài shāfā shang!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.reading: Āyí, zhè guō tāng zěnme bàn?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: 把汤倒在那个大碗里吧。小心，别把碗弄碎了。
dialogue.reading: Bǎ tāng dào zài nàge dà wǎn li ba. Xiǎoxīn, bié bǎ wǎn nòngsuì le.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: 你？你上次把我的杯子弄碎了！
dialogue.reading: Nǐ? Nǐ shàngcì bǎ wǒ de bēizi nòngsuì le!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 王明，我们一起洗。别把厨房弄乱了。
dialogue.reading: Wáng Míng, wǒmen yīqǐ xǐ. Bié bǎ chúfáng nòngluàn le.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.reading: Méi wèntí, wǒ huì xiǎoxīn de.
